title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt 4.04 (next-gen branch, DirectX 11)
description: Steam depot 292030 on the `next-gen` branch (4.04), launched directly from witcher3.exe with DXMT, msync and a 64-bit Windows 10 prefix. HairWorks off, borderless 2560x1600 High: the ossover benchmark profile.

steps.text: Keep HairWorks off (HairWorksLevel=0): it crashes under every Mac renderer.
Use dxmt, not dxvk: DXVK on macOS makes sirens, rotfiends and hounds invisible (no transform feedback in MoltenVK).

Never install the Steam client in this bottle; the depot was fetched with steamcmd and witcher3.exe runs DRM-free. A re-fetch without --allow-update is refused so Steam cannot move 4.04 to the DX12-only 5.x Remastered.
The launcher-configuration.json fallback is rewritten every time this recipe runs; re-apply it after any fetch.

knownIssues.symptom: Crash or hang when a character with HairWorks hair appears
knownIssues.cause: NVIDIA HairWorks has no working path on Metal
knownIssues.fix: Leave HairWorksLevel=0 in user.settings [Rendering]; the recipe sets it.

knownIssues.symptom: Sirens, rotfiends, hounds and some water effects are invisible
knownIssues.cause: DXVK on macOS lacks D3D11 stream output (MoltenVK has no VK_EXT_transform_feedback)

knownIssues.symptom: Game exits at once complaining about VCRUNTIME140.dll / MSVCP140.dll
knownIssues.cause: A missing Visual C++ runtime in the prefix
knownIssues.fix: Apply the separate recipe `ossover recipe apply witcher3-vcrun --bottle <bottle>` (winetricks vcrun2019 vcrun2013 vcrun2012; needs cabextract). It is not part of this recipe: Wine's builtin runtimes are the benchmark configuration and the ~100 MB download is only worth it on this abort.

knownIssues.symptom: Black screen after an update; bin/x64/witcher3.exe is gone
knownIssues.cause: Steam moved the install to 5.x Remastered, which is DirectX 12 only
knownIssues.fix: Fetch again with `ossover steam fetch --app 292030 --branch next-gen --allow-update` and re-apply this recipe.

knownIssues.symptom: Low or uneven frame rate with sync none or esync
knownIssues.cause: Only msync (CrossOver-derived engines) avoids wineserver round trips for Mach semaphores
knownIssues.fix: Use an engine with the msync capability; the recipe sets sync msync.

knownIssues.symptom: DXMT log: 'CreateGeometryShaderWithStreamOutput: not supported, expect problem' (seen 7x at startup on DXMT 0.80, observed 2026-10-14 on an M5 Pro)
knownIssues.cause: The game creates stream-output geometry shaders (used by some monster/particle effects); DXMT 0.80 has no stream-output support, same gap as DXVK-on-MoltenVK
knownIssues.fix: The game continues and the menu/world render; expect some effects (possibly sirens/rotfiends) to be missing on DXMT too. D3DMetal is the only path that implements stream output on macOS.
